method: All companies with an 8-K Item 4.02 notice filed 2021-2023 (EDGAR full-text search, first notice per company). Day 0 from the EDGAR acceptance time (at/after 16:00 ET -> next trading day). Returns from the last close before day 0 to the close N trading days after day 0, raw and minus IWM. Prices: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint (unofficial, adjusted closes); ticker from the EDGAR display name at filing time, then current SEC tickers; a result is used only if prices exist within a week of the notice. SPAC/shell = SIC 6770 or a SPAC-style name (see scripts/backtest.py). AAER = exact normalized-name match, release after the notice. Litigation = a later 10-K/10-Q/8-K of the company mentioning a 'class action complaint' near securities-law and case-caption words, within 2 years: possible, verify.
